function sfChartDist(ly): number;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/scale.ts:36

Piecewise distance → chart-units compression shared by the authored catalog, the deep-field point cloud and the registry fly-to math. Continuous at each break so close objects keep honest ratios: a body twice as far always lands twice as far within a tier, and the tier boundaries join smoothly (1 Mly → 10 000 units from either side).

Parameters

ly

number

Heliocentric distance in light-years.

Returns

number

Compressed chart radius in scene units.
